assets.prompt: Create a standalone architectural vignette for the CourseGraph interface. Image 1 is architectural subject reference: MIT Stata Center, its playful angular brick volumes and irregular windows. Image 2 is STYLE reference only: match the delicate hand-drawn building illustration at the lower left, graphite contours, unfinished architectural pencil lines, soft watercolor washes. Do not reproduce the interface or any typography. Reinterpret Stata Center as a lovely loose abstract architectural sketch with recognizable angular volumes, a calmer more level three-quarter composition rather than overwhelming tilted sky. Muted sage green, dusty blue, warm limestone, very subdued terracotta and pale ochre; airy, gentle, pleasantly colored, not monochrome. Sparse trees and ground pencil strokes, minimal detail. Wide landscape vignette with softly disappearing edges, genuine transparent background outside the drawing; no opaque paper rectangle, no sky rectangle, no text, no border. Art will be shown about 240 px wide; strong recognizable silhouette but light delicate linework. Artistic interpretation rather than accurate wayfinding drawing.
